ItemID: 1; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for keeping my hands clean during epoxy and adhesive work, after checking chemical compatibility.
ItemID: 2; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do plenty of repairs, but I have no current project needing a low-pressure gauge.
ItemID: 3; Title: toolant Four Sprial Flute Step Drill Bit, 1/8"-7/8"(3pcs) Impact Ready Titanium Coated Unibit Step Bit, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Metal, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Wood, Plastic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Enlarging holes in sheet metal would complement my drill bits and rivet tools, so I would choose this set.
ItemID: 4; Title: FOLIV 265PCS Black Self Tapping Screws, 8 x 1/2” to 1-1/2” (410) Stainless Steel Modified Truss Head Sheet Metal Screws Assortment Kit, Black Oxide Self Drilling, 6 Different Length Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The broad heads and different lengths look useful for fastening thin panels in my repair projects.
ItemID: 5; Title: [40 Pack] 1/4" x 1-1/4" OD Stainless Steel Fender Washer - Choose Size Metal Flat Washers for Bolts, 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These would complement my bolt assortment when I need to spread clamping force over a larger area.
ItemID: 6; Title: KRAKEN BOND Wow! Super Crazy Glue Clear - Strong Cyanoacrylate (CA) Glue for Plastic, Metal, Wood, PVC, Fast Curing Epoxy Adhesive | 3 Pack, 3.5 Oz.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Quick repair adhesive interests me, but I would check the conflicting cyanoacrylate and epoxy wording before choosing it.
ItemID: 7; Title: breesky Human Heart Torso and Skeleton Model 3D Model Study Tools for Anatomy and Physiology Students Sets of Three Human Anatomy Models Sciences Learning Kit for Kids…; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for workshop supplies, and I have no current need for anatomy study models.
ItemID: 8; Title: Self Tapping Screws Assortment Fasteners Set, 650pcs 304 Stainless Steel M3/M4/M5/M6 Sheet Metal Screws Kit with Storage Box,Phillips Drive Wood Screw Assortment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my fastening projects, but I already have several assortments and would choose the truss-head set this time.
ItemID: 9; Title: Forever Merci 50Pcs Black Thank You Merchandise Bags |2.36 mil Extra Thick/Large Size - 12″x15″|Plastic Shopping Bags for Small Business with Strong Die-Cut Handles|Reusable Plastic Thank you Bags; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for merchandise packaging in my DIY and repair work.
ItemID: 10; Title: KEYXE 8Pcs Screw Eyes, 3.2 Inch Black Eye Hooks Screw Self Tapping Eye, Heavy Duty Eye Bolt for Wood Securing Cables Wire, Hammock Stand, Indoor & Outdoor Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could suit a workshop mounting project, but I would wait until I need a specific anchor size and load capacity.
